readings: Considering only films with rental_duration >= 5 days (5 days counts as long), group them by original_language_id, with films that have no original language forming one group of their own. For each group compute the average rental_rate and the number of films. Then, treating each group equally, return as a single row the average of the group average rental rates and the average of the group film counts, in that order, unrounded.

Considering only films with rental_duration > 5 days (strictly more than 5 days, so 5 does not count as long), group them by original_language_id, with films that have no original language forming one group of their own. For each group compute the average rental_rate and the number of films. Then, treating each group equally, return as a single row the average of the group average rental rates and the average of the group film counts, in that order, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(film_count)
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY original_language_id)
